title: Calibration Technologists and Technicians
description: Execute or adapt procedures and techniques for calibrating measurement devices, by applying knowledge of measurement science, mathematics, physics, chemistry, and electronics, sometimes under the direction of engineering staff. Determine measurement standard suitability for calibrating measurement devices. May perform preventive maintenance on equipment. May perform corrective actions to address identified calibration problems.

tasks.text: Maintain or repair measurement devices or equipment used for calibration testing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical calibration and upkeep of test equipment

tasks.text: Verify part dimensions or clearances using precision measuring instruments to ensure conformance to specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Flaw location on physical products needs presence

dwas.name: Inspect finished products to locate flaws.

tasks.text: Conduct calibration tests to determine performance or reliability of mechanical, structural, or electromechanical equipment.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI interprets results; human runs physical tests

dwas.name: Test performance of electrical, electronic, mechanical, or integrated systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Read blueprints, schematics, diagrams, or technical orders.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Specs reading aided, human validates requirements

dwas.name: Review blueprints or specifications to determine work requirements.

tasks.text: Visually inspect equipment to detect surface defects.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical condition/function check needs hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect condition or functioning of facilities or equipment.

tasks.text: Calibrate devices by comparing measurements of pressure, temperature, humidity, or other environmental conditions to known standards.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical calibration of instruments requires hands

tasks.text: Write and submit reports about the results of calibration tests.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reports/evaluations drafted; human owns judgment

tasks.text: Disassemble and reassemble equipment for inspection.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disassembly for inspection is manual work

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment to inspect for deficiencies.

tasks.text: Analyze test data to identify defects or determine calibration requirements.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Derives specs from project data; human validates requirements

dwas.name: Evaluate characteristics of products.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

dwas.name: Analyze project data to determine specifications or requirements.

tasks.text: Plan sequences of calibration tests according to equipment specifications and scientific principles.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Detailed work plans drafted from specifications

tasks.text: Order replacement parts for malfunctioning equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

tasks.text: Develop new calibration methods or techniques based on measurement science, analyses, or calibration requirements.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts technical methods; expert validates feasibility

dwas.name: Develop technical methods or processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Attend conferences, workshops, or other training sessions to learn about new tools or methods.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI tracks technical updates; human validates depth

tasks.text: Draw plans for developing jigs, fixtures, instruments, or other devices.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI aids illustrations; precise technical drawing human
